META_DESCRIPTION: Budget on a variable paycheck: prioritise essentials, smooth good months into lean ones, and see what's truly safe to spend. Free to start, private, offline.
OG_DESCRIPTION: Irregular income? FincWin helps you budget from variable pay — prioritise essentials and smooth the highs into the lows.
PERSONA_HEADLINE: Budget when no two months are the same
PERSONA_SUBHEAD: Freelance, commission, seasonal — FincWin helps you fund essentials first and turn good months into a buffer for lean ones.
SITUATION_HEADLINE: A fixed monthly budget doesn't fit a variable paycheck
SITUATION_BODY:
When income swings month to month, ‘budget $X for groceries’ falls apart. A big month feels like permission to spend; a small one feels like panic.

FincWin works differently: you fund priorities in order as money arrives, and stash the surplus so the quiet months are already covered.
HOW_IT_HELPS:
• →Priority-first budgeting: fund essentials before extras, in the order that matters.
  • →Buffer the highs: route surplus from good months into a smoothing fund.
  • →Real safe-to-spend: see what's genuinely available, not just what's in the account.
  • →Trend insight: analytics show your average income so you can plan realistically.
